title: Multielectron Atoms (Summary)
notes: Written by Kyle Crabtree and shared under the book's CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

footnotes.html: Two electrons may share the same spatial orbital, with opposite spins; no two may share the same spin-orbital, and their total wavefunction is one antisymmetric function of both.

A Slater determinant is an antisymmetrized product of spin-orbitals. A linear combination of atomic orbitals is a different construction, the way molecular orbitals are built from atomic ones (Section 7.2).
The subscript is $J$ itself: a term symbol is $^{2S+1}L_J$. The level it names has $2J + 1$ states.
